comment: Three stabs a bar on the ands of 1, 2 and 3, rootless three-note voicings up at 64-80 so the clav sits a fourth above the guitar's scratch instead of in it, and nothing at all on step 4 of the bar. I stay out until bar 2 and let the section levels do the dynamics; the last six sixteenths of every bar are deliberately empty.
